newsitem.title: CHINA: HK's HACTL throughput up 16.7 pct in H1 1997.
newsitem.headline: HK's HACTL throughput up 16.7 pct in H1 1997.

text.p: Hong Kong Air Cargo Terminals Ltd (HACTL) said on Wednesday its throughput rose 16.7 percent to 779,468 tonnes in the first half of 1997, compared with the same period last year.
HACTL said in a statement exports climbed 18.4 percent to 351,559 tonnes compared with the first six months of 1996, while imports rose 13.1 percent to 329,796 tonnes.
Transhipments rose 23.8 percent to 98,112 tonnes, it said.
HACTL said it handled 138,117 tonnes of air cargo in June, up 16.6 percent compared with the same month last year.

The group said that "the steady growth registered so far since last year further underlines the phenomenal increase in regional air traffic within east Asia which would continue in the years to come".

HACTL is 25 percent held by Jardine Matheson Holdings Ltd, 20 percent by Swire Pacific Ltd, 12.5 percent by Wharf (Holdings) Ltd, 12.5 percent by Hutchison Whampoa Ltd and 10 percent each by CITIC Pacific Ltd, China National Aviation Corp and Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd.
